G2_completeness.justification: The statement specifies the limits, input format, mode values, validity condition, output format, and acceptance of any valid assignment.

G3_faithfulness.justification: Because det(R) = x² − y² and the allowed modes are positive, the rewritten condition is exactly equivalent to requiring conflicting workers to have different labels, with the same bounds and output requirements.

G4_naturalness.justification: The narrative is coherent and readable, though the elaborate acoustic terminology and invented matrix model make it more contrived than a typical programming problem.
